# Zprime_qq_m500

**AIDA-Scout C3 (control: low-mass dijet resonance)** -- generated by `make_signal_cards.py`.

A 500 GeV sequential Z' decaying to light quarks, giving two jets of roughly 250 GeV each. This is the standard 'the anomaly detector should not claim credit here' control: the event is comfortably inside the existing menu.

## Configuration

* Hard process: `NewGaugeBoson:ffbar2gmZZprime` with `Zprime:gmZmode = 3` (pure Z', no gamma/Z interference)
* m_Z' = 500 GeV, decays forced to u/d/s/c/b
* Cross section: **154.8 pb** (Pythia LO, no k-factor). This is the full sequential-Z' coupling strength and is deliberately unphysical as a signal rate -- it is a control, only the shape matters.

## Why it evades (or does not evade) the Phase-2 L1 menu

| Seed | Threshold | Fires? |
|---|---|---|
| PuppiHT | 450 (constituents pT > 30) | **YES** (HT ~ 500) |
| SinglePuppiJet | 230 | **YES** (~250 GeV jets) |
| QuadJet | 400,70,55,40,40 | no |
| DoubleTkMuon (BPH) | 2,2, abs(eta)<1.5, dR<1.4, OS, dz<1cm | no |
| DoubleTkMuon (central) | 4,4 | no |
| DoubleTkElectron | 25,12 | no |
| DoubleTkIsoPhoton | 22,12 | no |
| DoublePuppiTau | 52,52 | no |
| PuppiETmiss | 200 | no |


## Running

```bash
apptainer exec --bind $simdir \
  /cvmfs/unpacked.cern.ch/registry.hub.docker.com/jmduarte/mapyde:latest \
  sh $simdir/run.sh Zprime_qq_m500 <nevents> <seed> $simdir False
```

This point uses the **pythia** branch of `run.sh`.
